verdict.rationale: Veriff publishes an API reference with endpoint pages such as POST/GET /v1/sessions. Runnable examples come through an official Postman collection, and test integrations do not count toward paid usage, so calls can be tried safely. However, the runnable path relies on Postman as an external tool rather than an in-docs interactive console, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Missing for 10: an in-browser 'try it' console within the API reference, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
